info.name: Moolre API
info.description: Generated from the Moolre docs endpoint catalogue. Import this collection first, then import and select either the live or sandbox environment. SMS and WhatsApp use separate VAS API key variables.

item.name: SMS
item.description: Send SMS messages, manage Sender IDs, and retrieve SMS delivery or account status.

request.description:
The Send SMS (POST) API allows you to send bulk or single SMS messages to recipients across any network. Note: This API requires X-API-VASKEY in the header for authentication.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/sms/send

Request notes:
- `type`: ID of the sms sending function. Must be 1.
- `senderid`: Your registered and approved Sender ID (max 11 chars).
- `messages`: An array of message objects containing recipient, message, and optional ref.

response.name: 400 - Unapproved Sender ID
response.body:
{
  "status": 0,
  "code": "ASMS07",
  "message": "Sender ID is not approved, Please login on app.moolre.com and setup your Sender ID.",
  "data": "senderid",
  "go": null
}

request.description:
The Send SMS (GET) API allows you to send SMS instantly using query parameters.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/sms/send-get

Request notes:
- `type`: Must be 1.
- `senderid`: Registered and approved Sender ID.
- `recipient`: Recipient phone number.
- `message`: Message content (max 160 characters).

Check the delivery status of sent SMS messages. Note: This API requires X-API-VASKEY in the header for authentication.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/sms/status

Request notes:
- `type`: Must be 5.
- `ref`: Array of message references to check.

Request a new Sender ID for your SMS campaigns. Note: This API requires X-API-VASKEY in the header for authentication.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/sms/sender-ids

Request notes:
- `type`: ID of the sender ID creation function. Must be 3.
- `senderids`: An array of sender ID objects containing senderid (max 11 chars) and optional approve boolean.

response.name: 400 - Permission Denied
response.body:
{
  "status": 0,
  "code": "ASMQ09",
  "message": "You do not have permission to approve Sender IDs. Contact Customer Support.",
  "data": "senderid",
  "go": null
}

request.description:
Check the approval status of a Sender ID. Note: This API requires X-API-VASKEY in the header for authentication.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/sms/sender-ids/status

Request notes:
- `type`: ID of the sender ID status function. Must be 1.
- `senderid`: Sender ID to check.

Retrieve a list of all your registered Sender IDs along with their status. Note: This API requires X-API-VASKEY in the header for authentication.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/sms/sender-ids/list

Request notes:
- `type`: ID of the list sender IDs function. Must be 7.

response.name: 200 - Success

request.description:
Approve or reject registered Sender IDs. Note: This API requires X-API-VASKEY in the header for authentication and specific administrative permissions.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/sms/sender-ids/approval

Request notes:
- `type`: ID of the approve sender ID function. Must be 6.
- `senderids`: An array of sender ID objects containing senderid and approve (0 = Pending, 1 = Approved, 2 = Rejected).

response.name: 200 - Success
400 - Permission Denied
response.body:
{
  "status": 0,
  "code": "ASMQ09",
  "message": "You do not have permission to update Sender IDs. Contact Customer Support.",
  "data": "senderid",
  "go": null
}

request.description:
Check your SMS credit balance. Note: This API requires X-API-VASKEY in the header for authentication.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/sms/account-status

Request notes:
- `type`: Must be 2.

item.name: WhatsApp
item.description: Manage WhatsApp templates, send templated messages, and retrieve message status.

request.description:
Fetch your approved WhatsApp message templates. Note: This API requires X-API-VASKEY in the header for authentication.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/whatsapp/templates

response.name: 200 (Approved) - Success
200 (Rejected) - Success
200 (Pending) - Success

request.description:
Send batch WhatsApp messages using an approved template name. The unique reference (ref) is optional; however, without it, the message status cannot be tracked.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/whatsapp/messages

Request notes:
- `template_name`: The name of the approved WhatsApp template.
- `language`: The language code for the template (English only).
- `messages`: An array of message objects containing recipient, optional ref, and placeholders. Note: If ref is omitted, the status cannot be checked later.

response.name: 200 (Duplicate Refs) - Warning
401 (Insufficient Balance) - Insufficient Balance

request.description:
Track the delivery status of your WhatsApp messages using their unique references. Supports batch status checks.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/whatsapp/messages/status

Request notes:
- `ref`: An array of unique message references to check.

item.name: Account
item.description: Create and manage Moolre wallets, account settings, balances, and transaction history.

request.description:
Create a new business wallet/account.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/accounts/create

Request notes:
- `type`: Must be 1.
- `accountname`: Registered name of the business.
- `currency`: Currency code: GHS (Ghana Cedis).
- `api`: Set to true to enable API transactions for the new account.
- `callback`: Webhook URL for processing real-time transaction callbacks.
- `settlement`: Required settlement object. Leave frequency, channel, recipient, and sublist empty when automatic settlement is not configured.

response.name: 200 - Success
response.body:
{
  "status": "1",
  "code": "WC02",
  "message": [
    "Wallet Created Successfully",
    "Your wallet will be reloaded shortly or Click close to refresh now."
  ],
  "data": {
    "status": 1,
    "accountnumber": "100000157291",
    "accountname": "My Business LTD",
    "paymentid": "0757291",
    "api": 0,
    "callback": "",
    "settlement": {},
    "secret": "cf2a797f-c8d8-470c-a736-6f5f78ae1d86"
  },
  "go": [
    "wallets",
    "1.57291"
  ]
}

request.description:
Update business wallet/account details and settlement settings.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/accounts/update

Request notes:
- `type`: Must be 1.
- `accountnumber`: The account number you want to update.
- `currency`: Account currency. This endpoint always requires GHS.

Check wallet balance and status.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/accounts/status

Request notes:
- `type`: Must be 1.
- `accountnumber`: Account number to check.

response.name: 401 - Authentication Error
response.body:
{
  "status": 0,
  "code": "AIN04",
  "message": "Authentication Error, API Access not activated.",
  "data": "all",
  "go": null
}

request.description:
Fetch a list of transactions linked with a specific account.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/accounts/transactions

Request notes:
- `type`: Must be 2.
- `accountnumber`: Your Account Number.
- `enddate`: End date (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS). Defaults to the last second of the current year.
- `status`: Optional status filter: 0=Pending, 1=Successful, 2=Failed.

item.name: Transfer
item.description: Validate recipients, send payouts, move funds between Moolre accounts, and track transfer status.

header.description: Your API Key (accepts both Public Key and Private Key).

request.description:
Confirm the name of a Mobile Money or Bank Account holder before initiating a transfer.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/transfers/validate-name

Request notes:
- `type`: Must be 1.
- `receiver`: Phone number or bank account number.
- `channel`: 1=MTN, 6=Telecel, 7=AT, 2=Instant Bank Transfer.
- `sublistid`: Required when channel is 2 (Instant Bank Transfer). Use the bank code returned by Get banks.
- `currency`: Currency code: GHS (Ghana Cedis) or NGN (Nigerian Naira).
- `accountnumber`: Your Moolre Account Number.

header.description: Your API Key (accepts both Public Key and Private Key).

response.name: 400 - Not Found

header.description: Your API Key (accepts both Public Key and Private Key).

response.body:
{
  "status": 0,
  "code": "AVD02",
  "message": "Phone No. not found",
  "data": "Phone No. not found",
  "go": null
}

request.description:
Send money to a Mobile Money or Bank Account instantly.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/transfers/initiate

Request notes:
- `type`: Must be 1.
- `channel`: Numeric channel code: 1=MTN, 6=Telecel, 7=AT, or 2=Instant Bank Transfer.
- `currency`: Currency code: GHS (Ghana Cedis) or NGN (Nigerian Naira).
- `amount`: Amount to transfer. Must be greater than 0.
- `receiver`: Recipient mobile number (begin with 0) or bank account number.
- `sublistid`: Required when channel is 2 (Instant Bank Transfer). Use the bank code returned by Get banks.
- `externalref`: Unique reference for the transfer.
- `accountnumber`: Your Moolre Account Number.

response.name: 200 - Success
response.body:
{
  "status": "1",
  "code": "OBGH01",
  "message": [
    "Pay out Successful",
    "Click close to view transactions."
  ],
  "data": {
    "txstatus": 1,
    "receiver": "0246798993",
    "transactionid": "32759150",
    "externalref": "28171451",
    "thirdpartyref": "901733241086",
    "receivername": "YUSIF YA-ADZAGEY",
    "amount": "1",
    "amountfee": "1.01",
    "networkfee": "0.00",
    "fee": "0.01"
  },
  "go": null
}

header.description: Your API Key (accepts both Public Key and Private Key).

request.description:
Check the final status of a previously initiated transfer.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/transfers/status

Request notes:
- `type`: Must be 1.
- `idtype`: 1 = Unique externalref, 2 = Moolre Generated ID.
- `id`: The reference ID to check.
- `accountnumber`: Your Moolre Account Number.

header.description: Your API Key (accepts both Public Key and Private Key).

request.description:
Initiate an internal transfer using your Moolre account.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/transfers/internal

Request notes:
- `type`: Must be 1.
- `currency`: Currency code: GHS (Ghana Cedis) or NGN (Nigerian Naira).
- `amount`: Amount to transfer. Must be greater than 0.
- `receiver`: Destination Moolre account number. This must not be a mobile phone number.
- `externalref`: Unique reference for the transfer.
- `accountnumber`: Your Moolre Account Number.

response.name: 400 - Duplicate Reference
response.body:
{
  "status": "0",
  "code": "TR013",
  "message": "External Reference is required and must be unique.",
  "data": "externalref",
  "go": null
}

item.name: Payment
item.description: Collect payments, create payment IDs and bank accounts, generate payment links, and check payment status.

request.description:
Send a USSD payment request to a payer's phone number for approval.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/payments/initiate

Request notes:
- `type`: Must be 1.
- `channel`: Numeric channel code: 13=MTN, 6=Telecel, or 7=AT.
- `currency`: Currency code: GHS (Ghana Cedis) or NGN (Nigerian Naira).
- `payer`: Customer's phone number. Use the local 0-prefixed format.
- `amount`: Amount to collect. Must be greater than 0.
- `externalref`: Unique reference for the payment.
- `accountnumber`: Your Moolre Account Number.
- `skipotp`: Sandbox only. Set true to skip OTP simulation; defaults to false. Omitted from this environment-neutral sample request.

response.name: 200 (OTP Required) - OTP Required
response.body:
{
  "status": 1,
  "code": "TP14",
  "message": "Please complete the verification process sent to you via SMS and try again.",
  "data": "all",
  "go": null
}

response.name: 400 - Duplicate Reference
response.body:
{
  "status": "0",
  "code": "TP13",
  "message": "External Reference is required and must be unique.",
  "data": "externalref",
  "go": null
}

request.description:
Generate a unique permanent payment ID for use in making payments. In Live mode, customers dial *203*paymentid#; in Sandbox mode, they dial *203*6000*paymentid#.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/payments/payment-id

Request notes:
- `type`: ID of the function. Must be 2.
- `phone`: Phone number of the customer in +233 format (e.g., +233267606822).
- `name`: Name of the Customer or a Unique ID.
- `currency`: Currency of your account/wallet: GHS (Ghana Cedis) or NGN (Nigerian Naira).
- `amount`: Optional preset payment amount. Omit it to create a Payment ID without a preset limit; when provided, it must be greater than 0.
- `externalref`: Unique external reference for this request.
- `accountnumber`: Your Moolre Account Number.

Generate a permanent virtual bank account number linked to your wallet/account for secure payments.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/payments/virtual-account

Request notes:
- `type`: Must be 9.
- `currency`: Currency code: GHS (Ghana Cedis) or NGN (Nigerian Naira).
- `amount`: Optional initial amount. When provided, it must be greater than 0.
- `firstname`: First name of the account holder.
- `lastname`: Last name of the account holder.
- `phone`: Phone number of the account holder.
- `email`: Email address of the account holder.
- `externalref`: Unique external reference for this request.
- `accountnumber`: Your Moolre Account Number.

response.name: 200 - Success

request.description:
Check whether a Payment ID or bank account has been found and retrieve its account and transaction details.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/payments/account-status

Request notes:
- `type`: Must be 2 for Payment ID / Bank Account Status.
- `externalref`: The external reference used when initiating the Payment ID or bank account transaction.
- `accountnumber`: Your Moolre Account Number.

response.name: 200 (Not Found) - Not Found

request.description:
Create a hosted payment page URL. The Payment link system is used to generate a URL that opens a Moolre Web POS page for collecting payments.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/payments/links

Request notes:
- `type`: Must be 1.
- `amount`: Amount to be paid. Must be greater than 0.
- `email`: Email of the business.
- `externalref`: Unique ID to identify the payment.
- `reusable`: Determines if the link can be used for repeat payments. 0=No, 1=Yes.
- `expiration_time`: Link expiry time in minutes. Minimum 1 minute.
- `currency`: Currency of your account/wallet: GHS (Ghana Cedis) or NGN (Nigerian Naira).
- `accountnumber`: Your Moolre Account Number.

Check the final status of a previously initiated mobile-money payment collection (type 1). Use Payment ID / Bank Account Status for type 2 account lookups.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/payments/status

Request notes:
- `type`: Must be 1.
- `idtype`: 1 = Unique externalref, 2 = Moolre Generated ID.
- `id`: The reference ID to check.
- `accountnumber`: Your Moolre Account Number.

Moolre sends real-time HTTP POST notifications (callbacks) to your server when a payment is received or its status changes.

Docs route: https://docs.moolre.com/api/payments/webhook

Request notes:
- `status`: 1 for success
- `code`: P01
- `message`: Transaction Successful
- `data`: The transaction details
